# From Test to Trust — Maneesh Maddala

> Personal engineering portfolio and architectural field notes of Maneesh Maddala, Principal SDET Engineer at Morningstar, Inc. (Chicago, IL), with 15+ years of experience across repeatable quality engineering, enterprise test automation, and trustworthy AI systems.

## Primary Sections

- [About — Three Chapters of Quality Engineering](https://fromtesttotrust.com/): Evolution from exploratory domain testing to direct Playwright/Cypress engineering and production AI evaluation & guardrails.
- [Experience](https://fromtesttotrust.com/experience): 15+ years of engineering leadership at Morningstar, Inc., CSG International, Creospan Inc., and Tata Consultancy Services.
- [AI Systems](https://fromtesttotrust.com/ai-systems): Production AI architectures for multi-agent SDLC workflows, governed model routing, continuous evaluation, and automated defect triage.
- [Insights](https://fromtesttotrust.com/insights): Conference talks, webinars, and technical articles on Playwright reliability, AI guardrails, API testing, and structured output formats.

## AI System Architecture Briefs

- [Multi-Agent SDLC Workflow](https://fromtesttotrust.com/ai-systems/multi-agent-sdlc): Carries a Jira ticket through scenario planning, TestRail coverage analysis, and Playwright test generation with human review gates.
- [LiteLLM Gateway & Agent Sandbox](https://fromtesttotrust.com/ai-systems/litellm-gateway): Centralized model routing, Okta identity governance, AWS Bedrock/OpenRouter failover, and ephemeral ECS Fargate agent sandboxes.
- [Defect Triaging Agent](https://fromtesttotrust.com/ai-systems/defect-triaging-agent): Parses 1–50 Monocart Playwright HTML reports into compact evidence to classify flaky tests, hard failures, and duration regressions.
- [Support Intake & Triage Agent](https://fromtesttotrust.com/ai-systems/support-intake-agent): Unifies multi-channel support requests into a single Microsoft Teams queue and routes structured tasks into Asana.
- [Brand Unification & Compliance Skill](https://fromtesttotrust.com/ai-systems/brand-unification-skill): Evaluates live web properties against typography, color, accessibility, and brand rule sets with automated scoring.
- [Shared Agent Skills Platform](https://fromtesttotrust.com/ai-systems/shared-skills-platform): Central GitHub repository and validation pipeline for reusable engineering and domain agent skills.
- [Office Hours Knowledge Agent](https://fromtesttotrust.com/ai-systems/office-hours-agent): Converts recorded `.vtt` session transcripts into clean Markdown indexed semantically for cited Q&A.
